summary: Implemented the rich_measure and VerticalCenter feature without running tests or committing, per your instructions. Changes: rich/tree.py gets Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk, four cells of indent per level, Measurement import added). rich/align.py gets Align.__repr__, a width constraint from the measured maximum in __rich_console__, and a new public VerticalCenter class (render with newline padding, measure delegation, repr, JupyterMixin). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into collection. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased and adds an Added subheading with the two entries. tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, render, and measure tests. tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a tree measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Choices: the VerticalCenter render test uses width=10, and the tree level counter ends at -1 after the root iterator is exhausted, which is harmless. Tests have not been run.
